messages:
zain: Spun up verdigris-3b-int4 (fast PTQ per-tensor) on staging and ran a 1k redteam smoke. Posting raw thread for triage — saw a consistent softrefusal drop vs fp32.

claire: Oof. Numbers? any clear cohorts?

zain: Quick summary run command: `./eval/redteam.py --model verdigris-3b-int4-ptq --corpus rt_holdout_1k.json`
```
fp32_jb_rate: 0.08
ptq_jb_rate: 0.20
softrefusal_f1_fp32: 0.86
softrefusal_f1_ptq: 0.61
top_cohorts: persona_shift, chained_invoke
```

omar: That's a +0.12 jump. Did you use the same quant table and kernels as the lotus run?

zain: Same tokenizer, same decode params (`temp=0.0, top_k=40`). Using fast per-tensor profile. Logs show refusal trigram rank drops by ~4 positions; logit deltas ~-3.4.

nina: Any tokenization wobble or prefix splits? Sometimes persona markers get split and shift alignment.

zain: Good call — one failure trace shows persona prefix tokenized with an extra continuation token which moved the refusal marker across an attention block boundary. Possible compounding with quant noise.

safety-bot: Auto-eval (182999 (audit)): redteam_p50:0.19, redteam_p95:0.23, refusal_consistency_delta: -0.25 vs fp32. Flagged cohorts: persona_shift(0.30), chained_invoke(0.26). Recommend per-channel PTQ trial + microcalib on refusal logits.

claire: Plan: run (A) per-channel PTQ, (B) per-tensor + refusal-head rescale (heuristic x1.6) + kv-cache off. Capture tokenized prefix diffs and top-5 failure traces.

omar: Also suggest a tiny QAT microcalib (300 steps) on refusal/chain negatives if (A)/(B) don't recover >60% of gap. Keep dataset <2k to avoid regression drift.

ops-bot: Jobs queued: verdigris-perch-1830000201 (g4dn.xlarge, 90m), verdigris-ptq-rescale-1830000202 (g4dn.xlarge, 90m), verdigris-ptq-qat300-1830000203 (pending if needed).

zain: Will run A/B, post run ids and attach logits/token diffs to model-registry. If per-channel closes most of delta we'll add to profile matrix; otherwise micro QAT path. Will also enable a transient staging filter to block explicit tool/exfil tokens during demos.

claire: Thx. Please include deterministic seeds and single-sample traces for at least three canonical failures. That helps kernel/debug teams.

zain: Seeds and decode traces will be logged. Posting update when job artifacts available.
